meta.title: HR and Payroll
meta.subtitle: Digital employee records, vacation and leave, recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, performance, Colombian semi-monthly payroll and training, with the employee app and an AI policy assistant.
meta.sampleHint: Alimentos Valdeora S.A.S. is a fictitious company: people, tax ID, providers and figures are made up.
meta.seoDescription: Interactive demo with sample data: digital employee records, vacation in business days with Colombian holidays, recruiting with a rule-based fit score, onboarding and offboarding with final settlement, performance reviews, semi-monthly payroll with contributions and accruals, simulated electronic payroll and social security filing, and an AI policy assistant.

header.resetBody: This deletes the changes you made in this browser (requests, hires, payroll, reviews) and regenerates the data with today's date.

footer.sample: Sample data: Alimentos Valdeora S.A.S., its employees, the candidates, health providers, pension funds, family benefit funds, the occupational risk insurer and the banks are fictitious. Payroll parameters (minimum wage, transport allowance, UVT, working hours and surcharges) are 2026 sample values: in your project they are configured and validated with your labor and accounting advisors.
footer.integrations: Electronic payroll submission to the DIAN, the social security filing, the bank payment file, the electronic contract signature and the delivery of surveys and reminders are simulated in the demo; in your project they connect to your electronic payroll provider, your social security operator, your bank and your communication channels. The policy assistant does use real AI from our server.
footer.storage: Your changes are stored only in this browser for 7 days. Use “Reset data” to go back to the initial state.

assistant.persona: You are the HR assistant of Alimentos Valdeora S.A.S., a fictitious company in a demo. You answer employees in English, in at most 4 clear sentences. Use only the sample internal rules and policy documents and mention the article or item that applies. If the answer is not in the documents, say so and suggest writing to HR.
assistant.intro: Answers with AI using only the company's sample internal rules and policies, and cites the source.
